en.welcome_new: Welcome to Orbit, {name}! You've logged in to the station, the hub of the whole simulation, as its newest {job}. Type help to see what you can do.
en.whats_new: New on the station: you walk with directions now (n, s, e, w, up, down; look lists the exits, and way to the cantina gives the steps), and there's much more to do: a daily bonus (daily), levels (rank, profile), your own farm plots in Hydroponics, mining at the Asteroid Belt, and gadgets at Star Supply on the East Promenade. Type help for more.
en.daily_ready: Your daily bonus is waiting: type daily.
en.replaced: You've connected from somewhere else, so this connection is closing.
en.moved_away: This character has just been moved to another computer. This connection is closing.
en.server_restart: The station's computer is restarting. Orbit will reconnect by itself in a moment.
en.slow_down: Easy, not so fast! Wait a moment.
en.unknown_command: The station's computer doesn't know that command.
en.unknown_text: I don't understand "{what}". Type help for the commands.
en.oops: Something went wrong on the station's computer. Try again.
en.help: Help topics: type help moving, help talking, help work, help money or help shops. To start: look, then n, s, e or w (up, down) to walk; way to the cantina; say hello; who; inventory; profile; daily.
en.help_moving: Moving: walk with n, s, e, w, ne, nw, se, sw, up and down (or north, south, east, west...; in Indonesian utara, selatan, timur, barat, naik, turun; the Indonesian u is north). look lists the exits; look north peeks next door. way to the cantina gives the steps from here (a mapper knows more places). map describes the deck, where am I names the room and deck, compass your heading. ride the Kancil flies between the Dock and the Asteroid Belt. Your cabin is south of the Crew Quarters: invite Sari, then Sari types visit and your name. Dark tunnels need a headlamp, locked doors a keycard, and outside an EVA suit.
en.help_talking: Talking: say hello (or start with a quote mark), whisper Sari see you soon (anyone, anywhere), shout hello everyone, gestures like smile, wave, laugh, hug Sari. who lists who is online, look at Sari describes her, profile Sari shows her progress. friends, and add friend Sari: with a communicator you hear when friends log in, and locate Sari finds her. Orbit itself: voices off, speech off, ignore Budi, my voice 3, settings.
en.help_work: Work: type work at your workplace. Engineers repeat the reactor's tones in Engineering (the Reactor Core pays more); pilots fly cargo to the Moon from the Dock; traders get a market report anywhere; scientists find the next number in the Science Lab; security officers spot the smuggler in the Cargo Bay. Answer with the numbers. Work and missions give XP: levels raise your pay and bring keycards, and rank shows your progress. The daily mission board: missions, accept 1, take, complete.
en.help_money: Money: daily gives a bonus once a day, bigger with a streak. The market on the Promenade: prices (prices crops, prices ore), buy 2 coffee, sell all ore. The farm in Hydroponics: plots, plant tomato, water, harvest; crops grow in real time, from ten minutes to a day. Mining at the Asteroid Belt: ride the Kancil from the Dock, then mine; the Asteroid Surface and the Crystal Cave are richer. Salvage outside the hull with collect. Credits are only for playing: they have no real-money value, and can't be bought or cashed out.
en.help_shops: Shops: Star Supply on the East Promenade sells devices, tools, seeds, furniture, clothes, titles and pets; the Cantina's bar sells iced coffee and snacks; Hydroponics sells seeds. list shows what's for sale, buy mapper buys, examine mapper says what it does. use X uses a thing (drink, eat, place beacon); wear X and remove X for a headlamp, an EVA suit, clothes or a title. A mapper knows the way to places you've been, a scanner shows who is nearby, a headlamp lights dark tunnels, keycards open doors, and an EVA suit lets you outside.
en.help_admin: Admin commands: grant Budi 500, take credits Budi 100, give item Budi headlamp, economy, set price coffee 20 (for an hour), reset streak Budi, go to the Bridge or goto Budi, invisible, transfers, revoke Budi, transfer code for Budi, admin log; mute Budi 10, unmute, kick, ban, unban, announce followed by the text.

id.help: Topik bantuan: ketik bantuan bergerak, bantuan ngobrol, bantuan kerja, bantuan uang, atau bantuan toko. Untuk mulai: lihat, lalu u, s, t, atau b (naik, turun) untuk berjalan; arah ke kantin; bilang halo; siapa; tas; profil; harian.
id.help_moving: Bergerak: jalan dengan u, s, t, b, tl, bl, tg, bd, naik, dan turun (atau utara, selatan, timur, barat, timur laut, barat laut, tenggara, barat daya; dalam bahasa Inggris n, s, e, w, up, down). lihat menyebutkan jalan keluar; lihat utara mengintip ruangan sebelah. arah ke kantin memberi langkah dari sini (pemeta tahu lebih banyak tempat). peta menggambarkan dek, di mana aku menyebut ruangan dan dek, kompas arahmu. naik kancil terbang antara Dermaga dan Sabuk Asteroid. Kabinmu di selatan Lorong Kabin Kru: undang Sari, lalu Sari mengetik kunjungi dan namamu. Terowongan gelap butuh senter kepala, pintu terkunci butuh kartu akses, dan luar stasiun butuh pakaian EVA.
id.help_talking: Ngobrol: bilang halo (atau awali dengan tanda kutip), bisik Sari sampai nanti (ke siapa saja, di mana saja), teriak halo semua, gerakan seperti senyum, lambai, tertawa, peluk Sari. siapa menyebut siapa yang online, lihat Sari menggambarkannya, profil Sari menunjukkan kemajuannya. teman, dan tambah teman Sari: dengan komunikator kamu diberi tahu saat temanmu masuk, dan lacak Sari menemukannya. Pengaturan Orbit: suara pemain mati, bacakan pesan mati, abaikan Budi, suaraku 3, pengaturan.
id.help_work: Kerja: ketik kerja di tempat kerjamu. Insinyur mengulang nada reaktor di Ruang Mesin (Inti Reaktor bayarannya lebih besar); pilot mengantar kargo ke Bulan dari Dermaga; pedagang dapat laporan pasar di mana saja; ilmuwan menebak angka berikutnya di Laboratorium Sains; petugas keamanan mencari penyelundup di Gudang Kargo. Jawab dengan angka. Kerja dan misi memberi XP: level menaikkan bayaranmu dan memberi kartu akses, dan peringkat menunjukkan kemajuanmu. Papan misi harian: misi, ambil misi 1, ambil, selesaikan misi.
id.help_money: Uang: harian memberi bonus sekali sehari, makin besar kalau beruntun. Pasar di Promenade: harga (harga panen, harga bijih), beli 2 kopi, jual semua bijih. Kebun di Kebun Hidroponik: lahan, tanam tomat, siram, panen; tanaman tumbuh sungguhan, dari sepuluh menit sampai sehari. Menambang di Sabuk Asteroid: naik kancil di Dermaga, lalu tambang; Permukaan Asteroid dan Gua Kristal lebih kaya. Memulung di luar stasiun dengan kumpulkan. Kredit hanya untuk bermain: tidak bernilai uang sungguhan, tidak bisa dibeli, dan tidak bisa dicairkan.
id.help_shops: Toko: Toko Bintang di Promenade Timur menjual perangkat, alat, bibit, perabot, pakaian, gelar, dan peliharaan; bar Kantin menjual es kopi dan camilan; Kebun Hidroponik menjual bibit. daftar menunjukkan barang yang dijual, beli pemeta untuk membeli, periksa pemeta untuk tahu gunanya. pakai X untuk memakai barang (minum, makan, memasang suar); pasang X dan lepas X untuk senter kepala, pakaian EVA, baju, atau gelar. Pemeta tahu jalan ke tempat yang pernah kamu datangi, pemindai menunjukkan siapa di dekatmu, senter kepala menerangi terowongan gelap, kartu akses membuka pintu, dan pakaian EVA membuatmu bisa keluar stasiun.
id.help_admin: Perintah admin: beri kredit Budi 500, ambil kredit Budi 100, beri item Budi senter, ekonomi, atur harga kopi 20 (selama sejam), reset harian Budi, pergi ke Anjungan atau goto Budi, tak terlihat, pindahan, cabut akses Budi, kode pindah untuk Budi, log admin; bisukan Budi 10, unmute, tendang, ban, unban, umumkan diikuti teksnya.
